promptEs: Escribí el cifrado latino equivalente al cifrado americano Dm7.
promptEn: Write the Latin chord symbol equivalent to the American chord Dm7.
explanationEs: Dm7 se convierte en Rem7: D pasa a Re y F a Fa, manteniendo la m7 menor.
explanationEn: Dm7 becomes Rem7: D becomes Re and F becomes Fa, keeping the minor m7.
